\begin{example} \end{example}[souls of the flat cylinder]

Source: petersen:page-0476 ↗ def:pet-ch12-totally-convex 1. ch12:12.4.3On the flat cylinder $\mathbb {R}\times S^1$, every circle $\{ p\} \times S^1$ is a geodesic and totally convex; no point of $M$ is totally convex, and every such circle is a soul. \end{example}
